summary: Phase 2 Selbrucivo platform tested. Backend: 34/34 pytest cases pass on the public URL covering auth, onboarding, admin auth, portrait-validation upload, feed scopes, mine, library/me, moderation (approve/reject) round-trip, metrics, and verification that no engagement endpoints (likes/comments/followers/reactions/messages/wallpapers/classes/check_ins) exist. Frontend: testuser/password123 login → /ambient works; Local/Global scope and All/Ill/Anim/Des filter chips render; bottom-tab Library shows 'Tampa, FL · USA', '9 works archived', '1 MEMBERS', and guild breakdown; Profile shows IDENTIFIER, Guild/Library, 9 ARCHIVED/3 PENDING/1 WITHHELD with status-tagged inscriptions; Upload tab renders form with file picker and validation copy; Admin login screen renders with credentials form. A critical backend bug found via code review (see RCA).

critical.issue: ensure_local_library() uses find_one({'slug': slug}, {'_id': 0}) — excludes _id when an existing library is found. The caller then computes library_id = library.get('id') or library.get('_id') which is None. The user is then saved with library_id=None and the existing library's member/guild counters are never incremented. Only the FIRST onboarder to a city gets a valid library_id. Every subsequent user joining the same city is silently broken (no feed, library/me 404, uploads inherit library_id=None).

minor.issue: Verbose check passes, but library_id stored on user may be the actual Mongo _id (string) — works only because new libraries are inserted with our generated _id.
Returns 403 'Not visible' for pending artworks even to the uploader if the uploader_id comparison is wrong, but currently looks correct; ok.

ui_bugs.issue: Submit may not have data-testid='register-submit-button' OR click did not fire (URL stayed on /auth/register). Could not verify register→/onboarding routing via Playwright. Please confirm submit button data-testid and re-test.
Logout control labeled 'LEAVE THE ARCHIVE' lacks data-testid='logout-button'. Add data-testid to make the logout flow testable.
Could not confirm submit testid. Fields visible but testids data-testid='admin-username-input'/'admin-password-input'/'admin-submit-button' did not match. Please verify/add.

issues: Bottom-tab nav icons have no visible labels and very low contrast against the ambient artwork; first-time users may not realize they are tabs.
React Native Web emits 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' and 'shadow* style props deprecated' on every screen. Cosmetic but worth cleaning.

action_items: FIX: In server.py ensure_local_library(), drop the {'_id': 0} projection and instead return {...existing, 'id': existing['_id']} (or remove the projection and let library_id = library.get('_id')). Without this, ANY user who joins an already-existing city library ends up with library_id=None.
Add data-testid='register-submit-button' and admin-submit-button if missing; add data-testid='logout-button' on Profile screen logout control.
After fix, retest: register flow → onboarding → ceremony → ambient; second user joining Tampa should increment Tampa member_count to 2.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG: ensure_local_library strips _id then returns the existing doc, breaking library_id assignment for all repeat onboarders.
GET /api/artworks/feed?scope=global short-circuits to [] if no global libraries — correct, but consider documenting.
JWT_SECRET defaults to a hard-coded string if not in env — acceptable for dev, but flag as warning for prod.
library_id is stored as the same string id used as _id; consistent. ensure_local_library, however, accidentally hides it (see critical bug).

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (core flows verified; register/admin submit selectors and logout testid blocked further automation)

test_credentials: testuser/password123 (onboarded, Tampa FL); admin/admin123 (curator). Both present in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: During tests I created several TEST_-prefixed artworks for testuser (now approved/rejected/pending). They are visible in the seeded testuser's Profile and the Tampa feed; non-destructive to seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — reusable as regression. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env (already set in shell). Frontend Playwright sessions are not preserved across browser_automation_tool calls — login + flow must be done in a single script. The register-and-admin-login flows could not be fully exercised because submit buttons lacked the expected data-testid (or testid names differ). Critical library-id bug needs fix before retesting multi-user onboarding.
rca of the issue:
RCA — ensure_local_library bug:
  Reproduction:
    1. Onboard user A with city=Boston (creates library, _id=X).
    2. Onboard user B with city=Boston.
    3. GET /api/auth/me on B → library is null, library_id is null.
    4. POST /api/artworks/upload as B → artwork.library_id = null, won't show in any feed.
  Root cause: 
    `existing = await db.local_libraries.find_one({'slug': slug}, {'_id': 0})` (line 189) projects away _id. The caller computes `library_id = library.get('id') or library.get('_id')` (line 347) — both are None.
  Fix:
    Either remove the projection — `find_one({'slug': slug})` then return `{**existing, 'id': existing['_id']}` — or change the caller to use a known key. Recommend simplest: drop projection and let library_id = existing['_id'].
